tests: [screenshot.test] Screenshots Page.screenshot should take fullPage screenshots without captureBeyondViewport
reason: The test's point is the `captureBeyondViewport: false` path, which resizes the viewport to the page's height and restores it; its golden is the same 500×1000 image as the default capture's. Strider has no such option, so without it the test would repeat "should take fullPage screenshots". The nearest matrix row is the full-page option's

tests: [screenshot.test] Screenshots Page.screenshot should clip clip bigger than the viewport without "captureBeyondViewport"
reason: captureBeyondViewport: false clips the capture to the viewport (the golden is 25×25, against 25×100 for the default). Strider has no such option, and a clip is always a rectangle of the page. The nearest matrix row is the clip's

Puppeteer's `encoding: 'base64'` returns a string for the caller to decode. Strider returns the image's bytes as a Uint8Array and has no encoding option, so there is no Strider behavior to test; the test's only check is the golden, decoded from base64

tests: [screenshot.test] Screenshots Cdp should work in "fromSurface: false" mode
reason: fromSurface selects Chromium's CDP capture path (Page.captureScreenshot), which Strider's capture doesn't expose. The test's only check is that the screenshot is defined

tests: [screenshot.test] Screenshots ElementHandle.screenshot should use element clip
decision: Options a caller writes carry no `_tag`
reason: An element's capture can't also take a clip: Strider's `area` is one of its values, so the element and the clip can't be given together. The nearest matrix row is the clip's

tests: [screenshot.test] Screenshots ElementHandle.screenshot should work with webp
reason: Strider has no WebP capture: its format is PNG or JPEG (`ScreenshotFormat`). The test takes a page capture with `type: 'webp'`, so the page and element rows both apply; the matrix marks webp as has in `option-page-screenshot-type` and `option-elementhandle-screenshot-type`, which is wrong

tests: [screenshot.test] Screenshots Cdp should use scale for clip
reason: Puppeteer's clip `scale` multiplies the clip's pixels (a 150×100 clip at scale 2 is 300×200). Strider's `scale` is `css` or `device`, with no multiplier. The nearest matrix row is the scale's

tests: [screenshot.test] Screenshots Cdp should render white background on jpeg file
reason: Stock WebKit screenshots are PNG only, so a JPEG capture is refused as Unsupported

tests: [screenshot.test] Screenshots Cdp should render white background on jpeg file
reason: Firefox refuses `omitBackground` as Unsupported (`screenshot.omitBackground`), where Puppeteer's Firefox captures a transparent background. The matrix row has no per-browser entry for it
